messages:
alex (CEO): Heads-up — All-hands this Thursday 10:00am PT (calendar invite sent). Agenda: • Strategy update • Hiring policy change (referral & leveling) • Product launch timelines • Q&A. Drop questions here or add to Notion: https://notion.redwood/company/all-hands. Recording will be posted after. If you can't attend, leave questions and we'll answer during the meeting. :loudspeaker:

maya (VP Product): Deck posted — https://notion.redwood/company/all-hands/deck. If your team has a 1-slide launch update, add it under "Launch Callouts" by Wed EOD. Keep slides concise (1–2 bullets).

kevin (Eng Manager): Quick Q — will Dedicated beta be July or August? Trying to align sprint planning.

maya (VP Product): Plan today is limited beta in July (internal + select customers). We'll confirm exact dates in the all-hands and in the follow-up notes.

sam (People Ops): Hiring policy TL;DR: moving to calibrated leveling + updated referral bonus structure. New process doc: https://hr.redwood/leveling. Questions welcome here or DM. Changes effective next pay cycle.

lisa (Finance): We'll present updated FY outlook in the all-hands. Please treat the financial slides as internal until we publish — do not share externally.

jen (Marketing): Quick reminder: embargo on launch comms until we sign-off with comms. If you expect any external mentions, ping #marketing or @jen before posting.

deploy-bot: Reminder: all-hands meeting scheduled Thu 10:00 PT. Recording + transcript will be auto-uploaded ~15m after the meeting to /company/allhands.

[--- meeting happened ---]

alex (CEO): Thanks for joining — recording and TL;DR below. Recording: https://redwoodin.co/recordings/1795005432. TL;DR: 1) Strategic focus: double down on serving/runtime optimizations and customer tooling. 2) Hiring: new leveling calibration + referral bump (see HR doc). 3) Dedicated beta targeted for July (signup form will go live next week). 4) Ops: pushing stronger SLAs and fallback policies.

alex (CEO): Questions we didn't get to: 
- Will Dedicated pricing be different for existing customers? Answer: yes, pricing/commit tiers will be shared by Finance next week.
- What support for private deployments? Answer: Private stays on roadmap; expected GA timeline later this year.

sam (People Ops): Filed follow-ups from Q&A into the HR doc and added an FAQ section (link above). If you raised a question in-thread and didn't see an answer, I took notes and will follow up.

maya (VP Product): Updated deck with minor clarifications and the timeline slide: https://notion.redwood/company/all-hands/deck#updated.

jen (Marketing): Posted a short summary for internal comms in #announcements — please read before sharing with external partners.

alex (CEO): Appreciate everyone who sent questions in advance — if you asked something we didn't cover, we'll publish answers in the follow-up doc by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
